about_the_game:
You are an Operator of the transnational corporation Synclit, which has developed a technology for deep immersion into the human subconscious. Its purpose is to help people overcome fears, complexes, and inner barriers in order to achieve personal integrity.

Using a specialized device, you enter a simulation and explore the digital projection of the mind. Guided by your curator, you must complete missions, build your deck, and face manifestations of the subconscious — from fear and paranoia to fragmented memories. Each dive is unique: the environment and challenges change, and new cards open up fresh strategies.

In Synclit you will:

  • Build and refine your deck of psychological tools, unlocking new cards and discovering unexpected synergies.

  • Confront mental defenses — fears, distortions, and memory guardians — by adapting your tactics.

  • Collect data and findings that help you adapt to new challenges and progress deeper.

  • Explore shifting projections of the mind, where paths, events, and trials change with each run.

  • Uncover new secrets and opportunities — successful missions grant access to hidden layers of the subconscious and new mechanics.

How far will you be able to descend into the subconscious? Explore, adapt — and uncover what lies within.

name: SYNCLIT

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 (4 cores) / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (4 cores)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 (4 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 570 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 / RTX 3060 (8 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Synclit is a psychological roguelike deckbuilder about a journey into the subconscious. Build your deck, confront fears and inner barriers, and uncover the hidden secrets of the human mind.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support
